note: Exporter of fresh table grapes (HS 08061000) from Janori ICD, Nashik district, Maharashtra; registered address on the customs page reads "A/P-UGAON TAL-NIPHAD" (Niphad taluka, Nashik). Real, dated, named-buyer export shipments to the Netherlands and Qatar are confirmed from customs bill-of-lading records, so this is a genuine supplier, not a catalogue claim. Domestic supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, annual-report splits) could NOT be retrieved: DuckDuckGo search backend returned 'Connection refused' on every query, and zaubacorp.com, thecompanycheck.com, volza.com, eximpedia.app all returned HTTP 403 Forbidden. Revenue and domestic turnover therefore recorded as null — not invented. Role: producer company that also acts as an exporter/aggregator of member produce (manufacturer_trader-like), not a pure trader. No sanctions/court/HS issues relevant here; HS code declared by the requester is correct as-is. Note the second slug variant 'om-gayatri-farmer-producer-company-ltd' exists but its free view is gated ('Join ImportKey to view the import and export data records'), so only the '-limited' slug yielded records.
